title: Monochromatic reachability or rainbow triangles

model_contract.hypothesis: D is a tournament whose arcs use three colors.
model_contract.conclusion: D has a rainbow directed triangle or a vertex that reaches every vertex by monochromatic directed paths.
model_contract.counterexample_condition: D is a tournament whose arcs use three colors. and NOT (D has a rainbow directed triangle or a vertex that reaches every vertex by monochromatic directed paths.)
model_contract.witness: A sorted colored-arc list and exhaustive reachability and triangle tables.
